args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note from Sofia Marchetti on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026.
- "PHL" now matches two accounts. Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. Pellucid Harbor Logistics rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. Filtering on PHL returns both.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That label still carries the old name and needs to read Pellow Home Living.

Sofia is out, so Bettina Kroll is covering this account.

Thanks,
assistant (on behalf of Bettina Kroll, #coastal-team)

args.text:
Bettina, the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com), subject "PHL label cleanup", is saved in the assistant mailbox. It has not been sent.
